senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) ripe, boiled, done. זרוע בשלה the boiled shoulder due to the priest (Num. VI, 19).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 98a:18">Ḥull. 98ᵃ</cite> bot. both derive it <he>מז׳ ב׳</he> from the process prescribed for the priest’s gift &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 98b:1">Ib. 98ᵇ</cite> top <he>אין ב׳ אלא שלמה</he> when it says, ‘the shoulder boiled’ it means entire (not carved).

<cite ref="Chullin 98b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אין ב׳ אלא שנתבשל וכ׳</he> when it says, ‘He shall take &c. from the ram’ it means that it must be boiled joined to (or jointly with) the body of the ram. Tanḥ. Vayera 5 Abraham <he>בלעה בשילה</he> swallowed the fig ripe, i.e. spoke deliberately, opp. <cite ref="Q00041"><he>פגה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>אמר בישולה</he> (corr. acc.).
